StringWithMarkup.String: Oxyfluorfen is an orange crystalline solid. Non corrosive. Used as an herbicide.
Oxyfluorfen is an aromatic ether. It has a role as a herbicide and an EC 1.3.3.4 (protoporphyrinogen oxidase) inhibitor.

Oxyfluorfen is a selective pre and postemergent herbicide used to control certain annual broadleaf and grassy weeds in vegetables, fruit, cotton, es] ornamentals and on non-crop areas. It is a contact herbicide and light is required for it to affect target plants.
